objective: Complete the explicit Local-Group peak posterior with statistically valid high-k Gaussian degrees of freedom while preserving every promoted CF4 N192 parent exactly, then use forward z=0 observables to select zoom candidates whose IC particle spacing is below 0.3 cMpc/h.

promoted_posterior.representation: Equal-weight geometry particles with an exact 256-parent conditional probability vector on every particle.

probability_contract.joint_state: Choose geometry particle g from the equal-weight promoted bank, then choose parent j from P(j|g), then draw the N576 field from p(x576|y_j,g,LG_peak).
probability_contract.peak_evidence_policy: The promoted bank already contains the normalized LG peak evidence. Do not multiply by peak evidence again after drawing a joint state.
probability_contract.z0_weight: After equal-weight posterior resampling, the only new scientific weight is the preregistered normalized z=0 forward likelihood. A nonuniform screening or allocation probability would also require its exact inverse-probability correction.

information_firewall.CF4_information: The N192 parent density and velocity modes are the CF4-supported large-scale constrained realization.
information_firewall.explicit_LG_information: The two R=1.5 Mpc/h protohalo-centre targets, their twelve shell probes, latent midpoint, axis, and later MW/M31/M33 z=0 observables are additional Local-Group information, not information claimed to come from CF4.
information_firewall.unresolved_information: Modes not constrained by the N192 parent or the explicit LG likelihood remain LCDM conditional-Gaussian draws with random phases.
information_firewall.large_structure_policy: Virgo, Coma, Local Void, Bootes Void, and other CF4-supported structures are forward-validation observables; they may not be silently used to choose a parent or retune the LG likelihood.

resolution_ladder.requirement: The <=0.3 cMpc/h IC requirement is met in the Lagrangian LG zoom, not by claiming that the global N576 conditioning mesh itself has that resolution.
resolution_ladder.phase_policy: Every shared Fourier band is projected from the same canonical realization; it is never redrawn when changing mesh or zoom level.

joint_schedule.method: Perform one systematic resampling of the flattened geometry-parent joint probability independently within each bridge group.
joint_schedule.group_balance: Exactly 64 scheduled states from each of the four bridge groups.
joint_schedule.duplicates: Repeated geometry or parent indices are allowed and represent posterior mass; every repeat receives independent fine-field and mock-noise seeds.

schedule_gate.failure_action: Stop and diagnose the sampler. Do not search for a more favorable schedule seed.

conditional_field_engine.projection: Use the exact variance-preserving R/R* contract including every output-Nyquist equivalence class.
conditional_field_engine.covariance: Use the existing exact 27-phase AQA* cache; no stationary approximation.
conditional_field_engine.mock_noise: epsilon is an independent Gaussian likelihood-noise draw, which makes the output a posterior sample rather than a MAP edit.

technical_pilot.purpose: Exercise one prospectively fixed field from each bridge group without PM, halo finding, or science selection.
required_checks: direct small-mesh and cached-kernel controls agree
unconditioned null-space control retains LCDM power

forward_and_zoom_gates.PM_policy: Forward every scheduled state; no result-dependent early allocation.
forward_and_zoom_gates.M33: M33 is not a hard PM/FoF constraint; it is mandatory in the RAMSES unmerged-HOP/PHEW definitive gate.
zoom_sequence: Trace accepted z=0 particle IDs back to the IC to build the Lagrangian mask.
Run the L12/L19 pilot zoom and require HOP M200c, MW-M31 kinematics, M33, and contamination gates.
Only a passing pilot may advance to the L13/L21 production zoom.
forward_and_zoom_gates.Slurm: Every field, PM, and RAMSES execution is submitted through Slurm. Request measured or estimated peak memory plus 20 percent. Manual syn101 execution is forbidden.

implementation_sequence: Implement and test the joint schedule builder on synthetic posterior banks.
Run a read-only lineage and probability preflight on the promoted real bank.
Freeze and audit the one-shot 256-state schedule.
Implement the exact scalable conditional-field correction and small-mesh equivalence controls.
Request approval before submitting the four-field technical pilot.
Stop for technical-pilot evaluation before any PM production.
